evidence.text: A 5★ review from 2026-05-06 contains "unable to generate", text that only a chatbot or an unfilled template would produce, pasted in as a customer review.
A 5★ review from 2026-05-06 contains "unable to generate", text that only a chatbot or an unfilled template would produce, pasted in as a customer review.
The business shows 4.8★ from 5,000 reviews, but its latest 100 average 3.15★. For the display to hold, the other 4,900 must average about 4.83★.
Of 48 highest-rated reviews sampled, 33 were posted between 2025-02-19 and 2025-04-25; 75% come from accounts with at most one review.

3 of the 7 reviews long enough to judge read as AI-written to an AI model, which quotes the phrases behind each opinion. Real customers also polish honest reviews with AI, so these are shown, not counted.

caveats: This is a pattern, not proof.
Only the newest 100 reviews and the 10 highest-priority reviewers were examined.
Dates in reviewer histories are approximate.
Rings within a single city aren't detected.
Google may already have removed some reviews.
A business can be targeted without its knowledge: review-task scams hand recruits real businesses to review.
“Reads as AI-written” is an AI model's opinion. AI-text detectors are unreliable on short texts and over-flag people writing in a second language, so only longer reviews were judged.
